a.lede: Despite Nvidia's board saying it has no intention of bringing former CEO Jensen Huang back to the company, some directors are reportedly still pushing for that to happen.
a.title: Nvidia board faction angling for Jensen Huang return as CEO, report claims

b.lede: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.
b.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
